mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_setting (tenant_id, setting_group, setting_key, value_json, is_secret, credential_ref, creator_id, modifier_id, is_deleted) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{settingGroup}, #{settingKey}, #{valueJson}, #{isSecret}, #{credentialRef}, #{creatorId}, #{modifierId}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM system_setting WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND setting_group = #{settingGroup} AND setting_key = #{settingKey} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM system_setting WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND setting_group = #{settingGroup} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY setting_key
mapper.update: UPDATE system_setting SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = 0
